SELECT nvd_latest.member_no AS accountID , 'Server(VPC)' AS productID , 'NCP' AS csp , nvd_latest.demand_amount / ${krwPerUsd} AS bill , nvd_latest.instance_no AS resourceID FROM ( SELECT n1.instance_no, n1.member_no, n1.demand_amount FROM ncp_cost_vm_month n1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT instance_no, MAX(id) AS latest_id FROM ncp_cost_vm_month WHERE demand_month = #{year_month} GROUP BY instance_no ) n2 ON n1.instance_no = n2.instance_no AND n1.id = n2.latest_id ) nvd_latest INNER JOIN servicegroup_meta sm ON nvd_latest.instance_no COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = sm.csp_instanceid COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND sm.csp_type = 'NCP' WHERE 1=1
AND sm.service_cd IN
#{selectedProject}
AND 1=0
UNION ALL
SELECT nr_latest.member_no COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS accountID , CASE nr_latest.resource_type WHEN 'K8S' THEN 'Kubernetes Service' WHEN 'OBJECT_STORAGE' THEN 'Object Storage' ELSE nr_latest.resource_type END COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS productID , 'NCP' AS csp , SUM(nr_latest.demand_amount) / ${krwPerUsd} AS bill , nr_latest.resource_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS resourceID FROM ( SELECT n1.resource_id, n1.resource_type, n1.member_no, n1.demand_month, n1.demand_amount FROM ncp_cost_resource_month n1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT resource_id, demand_type_detail_code, contract_no, MAX(id) AS latest_id FROM ncp_cost_resource_month WHERE demand_month = #{year_month} GROUP BY resource_id, demand_type_detail_code, contract_no ) n2 ON n1.resource_id = n2.resource_id AND n1.demand_type_detail_code = n2.demand_type_detail_code AND n1.contract_no = n2.contract_no AND n1.id = n2.latest_id AND n1.resource_type != 'OBJECT_STORAGE' -- Object Storage 는 계정 단위 블록(D-4)에서 집계 ) nr_latest INNER JOIN servicegroup_meta sm ON nr_latest.resource_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = sm.csp_instanceid COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND sm.csp_type = 'NCP' WHERE 1=1
AND sm.service_cd IN
#{selectedProject}
AND 1=0
GROUP BY nr_latest.member_no, nr_latest.resource_type, nr_latest.resource_id
UNION ALL
SELECT nro.member_no COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS accountID , 'Object Storage' COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS productID , 'NCP' AS csp , SUM(nro.demand_amount) / ${krwPerUsd} AS bill , nro.resource_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS resourceID FROM ( SELECT o1.resource_id, o1.resource_type, o1.member_no, o1.demand_month, o1.demand_amount FROM ncp_cost_resource_month o1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT resource_id, demand_type_detail_code, contract_no, MAX(id) AS latest_id FROM ncp_cost_resource_month WHERE demand_month = #{year_month} AND resource_type = 'OBJECT_STORAGE' GROUP BY resource_id, demand_type_detail_code, contract_no ) o2 ON o1.resource_id = o2.resource_id AND o1.demand_type_detail_code = o2.demand_type_detail_code AND o1.contract_no = o2.contract_no AND o1.id = o2.latest_id ) nro WHERE nro.resource_type = 'OBJECT_STORAGE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM servicegroup_meta smo WHERE smo.csp_type = 'NCP' AND smo.service_type = 'OBJECT_STORAGE'
AND smo.service_cd IN
#{selectedProject}
)
AND 1=0
GROUP BY nro.member_no, nro.resource_id
